description: Connect the user's Shopify store to this brand. Returns ONE Shopify admin link for the user to open while signed in to Shopify: Shopify asks which store, installs the Hermoso app on it if it is not there yet (they approve its permissions), and they press Connect store. The link works for 30 minutes and connects nothing until they press it. Once connected, the Shopify tools work for that store: products, orders and the sales report, buyers who agreed to marketing email into the brand's email leads, orders to the brand's Meta pixel as conversions, blog posts, discount codes, product media and Shopify Marketing records. Work for the store is paid from this Hermoso account; nothing is charged through Shopify. One store per brand: connecting another replaces it. List_shopify_stores says what is connected. Free.
name: connect_shopify_store
title: Connect a Shopify store
